description: Returns one HODDS catalogue record by id (an option id returned by search_solutions): name, homepage, summary in English and French, processes (the first is primary), keywords, pricing models without amounts (empty means unknown) with the pricing page, interfaces (public API, MCP server, self-hosting: yes, no or unknown), markets, publisher, dated sources and status. Status non_attested means the publisher has not confirmed the record; unknown values are stated as unknown. Read-only.
name: get_solution

outputSchema.description: One software or service in the HODDS catalogue. Facts come from the publisher's own public pages, listed in sources. Unknown is a valid value. scripts/catalogue.mjs enforces these rules at build time, plus cross-record rules (unique ids and homepages, file name = id, folder = group of the primary process, real calendar dates).

data_portability.description: Documented export formats (lowercase) and catalogue ids of solutions the publisher documents an import from. Omitted, empty or without source = unknown.

data_residency.description: Regions where the publisher documents that customer data is stored: EU or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Omitted or empty = unknown.

founder_link.description: Declared link between the HODDS founder and the solution. Never affects ranking.

hodds_status.description: HODDS review status, distinct from status (publisher attestation). approved = reviewed by HODDS on checked_on, shown as "Approved by HODDS"; not_yet = listed, not reviewed yet, shown as "Not yet approved by HODDS". Absent means not_yet. Never affects ranking, candidates or the challenger.

id.description: Stable slug, unique in the catalogue. Equals the file name without .json.

mcp.description: official = MCP server or MCP feature published by the publisher (url = its documentation). community = third-party server (url = its repository). url is required for both.

keywords.description: Lowercase search terms in English and French describing what the solution does. Never another product's name. (scripts/catalogue.mjs checks lowercase for every script.)

markets.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes where the documented offer applies, or global. Omitted = not documented.

open_source.description: Whether the solution is published under an open-source licence. Omitted = unknown.

source.description: Pricing page that documents the models. Required when models is not empty.

processes.description: Process ids from catalogue/processes.json (checked by scripts/catalogue.mjs). processes[0] is the primary process and decides the folder catalogue/solutions/<group>/.

sources.description: Official pages actually read to write this record.

status.description: Publisher attestation. non_attested: the publisher has not attested this record. withdrawn is a reserved value for solutions that left the portfolio; no record carries it yet. Corrections: see /contribute/.

summary.description: Factual description taken from the official source. No superlatives, no comparisons, no unverifiable claims.

version.description: Current version as published by the publisher. source = the publisher's official page that states it.

withdrawn_on.description: Day the solution left the portfolio. Allowed only when status is withdrawn.

outputSchema.title: HODDS catalogue solution

title: Get a catalogue record
